classes.name: index
classes.reason: _consume computes budget_ns from the producer's broadcasted timing and aborts (returns missed=True) if probe.NS()-started exceeds budget_ns while reading each index file once via probe.read_staged, so the read must finish within that window or the unit's data is dropped, and only the consumer rank performing the read blocks (producers keep writing their own files independently).

classes.name: statistics
classes.reason: _report loops STATISTICS_READS=8 times over every producer/index file calling probe.read_staged synchronously with no timing check, so the consumer rank simply stalls on each of the 8 reads per file while producer ranks continue their own writes, with no deadline enforced.
